name: config-variable-table
goal: Configs lists only variable names and their source values at the selected revision.

evidence: Configs must show exactly Variable and Value columns, one row per source setting at the selected revision, with working search and detail links.

Existing explorer-catalog-screen test asserts module names and table markup only; entity-preview-groups checks grouping only; unit-metadata tests omit config initializer values. Extend these standardized suites for source values, history, columns, search, and navigation.
Committed metadata regression fails for missing configValues. Browser matrix fails expected two-column assertion at all three widths, with pre-assertion screenshots.
Source-derived config metadata feeds variable rows and two-column ExplorerTable; variable search and owning-entity links remain revision scoped.
